The vehicle presented with scraping and paint transfer along the right rear quarter panel, a cracked rear bumper cover at the right

described. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, repairing and refinishing the door and quarter panel, and
replacing the mirror housing. The labor hours requested fit the scope of this work. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on
this vehicle, and the invoices reviewed show no duplicate charges for the same parts or labor.
